recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the core repository. If a current build demonstrates that differential extension rows are again ordered incorrectly, fix the external Kindling/FHIR tooling and update the dependency used by this repository.
issue_request: FHIR-13299 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for STU3 asking generated differential views to show extension and modifierExtension rows where they belong in element order instead of moving them to the end.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 13122. Git commit c8b51e7adc717c021f5702d4505547e949496327 corresponds to that revision and changed implementations/java/org.hl7.fhir.r4/src/org/hl7/fhir/r4/conformance/ProfileUtilities.java by disabling the differential-only logic that skipped extension rows during normal child traversal and appended them after other children.
additional_context: The old in-repo ProfileUtilities.java renderer was later deleted by build/tooling refactors. Current HEAD no longer contains that Java source; build.gradle.kts declares org.hl7.fhir:kindling:1.25.5-SNAPSHOT and runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from the dependency classpath. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later FHIR-core decision reversing this ordering request.
reconciliation: No HL7/fhir source file was changed. The historical source change was applied, and any current renderer correction would need to be made in the external Kindling/FHIR tooling source and consumed here through a dependency update.
